notes: Release-cohort manifest instance (spec 14.8/17.4; F24 items 5 and 12): the tested ONB, 999, shared-launch-contract and Command Center versions/SHAs this release is bound to. onb_sha/cc_sha are the origin/main tips the release was tested at; onb_version is this repo's /version, cc_version is the pinned Command Center version (cc-compat.json commandCenter.pinnedTag, == CC /version); contract is the shared decision bridge schema version (shared-utils/decision-engine.py BRIDGE_SCHEMA_VERSION, == CC contract.ts DECISION_SCHEMA_VERSION). 'sources' is the machine-checkable extension required by F24 item 5: it identifies the four compatible distributions explicitly instead of only the ONB/CC pair. command_center.sha is the PEELED commit of the pinned tag (gh api repos/.../git/tags/<tag_object_sha> or `git ls-remote --tags <repo> refs/tags/<cc_version>^{}`), and command_center.tag_object_sha is the annotated tag object itself; scripts/roll-release-cohort.py --verify-cc-tag proves that peel against the live remote so cc_version and cc_sha cannot silently disagree again (the previous instance recorded cc_sha ef6b9364, the v7.6.112 merge commit, while naming cc_version v7.6.126). Read and validated by shared-utils/decision_engine_train/train.py::_load_cohort_manifest via shared-utils/decision_engine/modes/cohort.py::validate_cohort; promote() refuses a pair that does not match this exact tested pair. onb_version and cc_version are rolled by scripts/roll-release-cohort.py (called by bump-version.sh); onb_sha/cc_sha/n999_* are set at release time to the tested tips and the peeled SHA of the pinned CC tag.
